thread.title: Deep Dive: Here are Friday’s worst stock performers

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Deep Dive: Here are Friday’s worst stock performers
text:
It’s been a continual seesaw for stocks this week amid persistent worries of slowing global economic growth and concerns that companies have seen peak earnings growth. Friday continued the trend, starting out on a sour note following earnings reports from two of the biggest tech companies.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average
 DJIA, -0.47%
 was down as much as 2.2% in morning trading, while the S&P 500 index
 SPX, -0.69%
 lost as much as 2.9% and the Nasdaq Composite
 COMP, -0.76%
 declined as much as 3.6%.
Mixed results from Amazon.com
 AMZN, -6.15%
 disappointed investors and sent the shares down as much as 10% in morning trading. Google holding company Alphabet
 GOOG, -0.51%
 GOOGL, -0.36%
 beat analysts’ earnings estimates but reported sales that didn’t grow as fast as expected , and those shares fell as well.
More on market volatility:
• The stock market’s technical indicators are suggesting ‘the bottom is in’
• Don’t sell now — we’re not heading into a bear market for stocks
